analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Discipline

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price confirms Stage 2 momentum above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, clearing a 20-session resistance pivot to register fresh 52-week highs. RSI at 69 confirms strength without severe exhaustion, yet breakout lack of volume thrust hints at weak institutional backing.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Aarey Drugs exhibits weak fundamentals with quarterly net profit shrinking 26% and revenues falling 56% YoY. Operating profitability remains thin, ROCE sits at an anemic 5.6%, and 3-year average ROE is just 3.1%, failing basic CANSLIM quality hurdles.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails on a break below 104.62 stop; cut losses immediately without averaging down.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Constructing a constructive consolidation pattern within 1.5% of its 514.61 20-session pivot. Aligned swing lows show classic supply contraction along rising EMA21 and SMA50, with MACD firmly above zero and signal line confirming healthy Stage 2 accumulation.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Aarti Drugs delivered an earnings inflection with Q2 FY27 profit up 83% YoY to ₹82.8 crore on 27% sales expansion. ROCE stands at 12%, though net debt-to-EBITDA remains moderately elevated around 3.5x amid ongoing greenfield capex capitalization.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Pattern invalidates on a reversal beneath 454.95 support; execute strict risk containment to preserve capital.

AARTISURF.technical: Classic SEPA breakout above prior 20-session pivot, supported by powerful 3.15x average volume expansion. Moving average alignment (EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200) satisfies Minervini Trend Template criteria, confirming accumulation off a constructive base.
AARTISURF.fundamental: Aarti Surfactants demonstrated explosive operational leverage in Q1 FY27, with net profit surging 206% to ₹9 crore on 26% revenue growth. However, trailing return metrics are subdued with ROCE at 8.5% and ROE at 5.2%.
AARTISURF.risk: Setup fails if price drops below 580.74 pivot floor; exit immediately to maintain asymmetric risk-reward.

ABB.technical: Displays constructive high-level base consolidation within 1.5% of its 7706.70 pivot. Trades cleanly above rising 21-day EMA, 50-day SMA, and 200-day SMA with 1.69x volume expansion, confirming Stage 2 trend alignment and institutional sponsorship.
ABB.fundamental: ABB India boasts premier balance sheet quality with virtually zero debt, 29.9% ROCE, and 22.4% ROE. However, quarterly EPS growth of 8% falls well short of CANSLIM's 25% minimum acceleration threshold despite solid 19% top-line growth.
ABB.risk: Break below 7291.91 breaches base structure; close the trade immediately to avoid deep drawdowns.

ABDL.technical: Tightening in a high-handle consolidation within 1.5% of the 768.77 pivot on 1.45x average volume. Price structure adheres to Stage 2 parameters above upward-sloping EMA21 and SMA50, though overhead resistance requires a definitive volume surge.
ABDL.fundamental: Allied Blenders shows improving top-line momentum with revenue up 16% YoY and ROCE at 18.4%. However, EPS growth at 17% trails the 25% CANSLIM standard, high debtor days (168) persist, and recent promoter divestment prompts caution.
ABDL.risk: Violating the 714.10 stop level terminates the breakout premise; honor stops instantly as per SEPA rules.

AEGISVOPAK.technical: Dynamic SEPA breakout through 20-session resistance on massive 4.41x average volume expansion. Price holds firmly above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, with RSI at 69 verifying robust demand without technical exhaustion.
AEGISVOPAK.fundamental: Aegis Vopak maintains commanding infrastructure margins (~74% OPM) and strong long-term expansion tailwinds, but Q2 FY27 consolidated earnings slipped 4% YoY on modest 11% sales growth, failing both CANSLIM C and A acceleration tests.
AEGISVOPAK.risk: Failure occurs on a breakdown below 293.63 stop; preserve capital and cut the position immediately.
